emma_devex: FYI the onboarding sampleapp started failing rerank smoke tests when we enabled the new batching helper. Node embeddings come back with 1536 dims, Python with 1537, and the reranker throws a mismatch. Also saw a couple of 401s in the logs when the helper batched retries. Anyone seen this combo?

josh_infra: Noticed some auth noise last night in infra metrics. 401 spikes align with a retry window. Do you have request/response snippets?

emma_devex: Paste (sanitized):
```bash
# Node reproduce
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":["x"],"model":"rwd-embed-1536"}'
# partial response
{"data":[{"id":"0","vector":[0.0001,0.002,...]}]}
```
Python client returns `{"data":[{"id":"0","embedding":[...,0.091]}]}` (1537 floats). Rerank client expects `vector` and 1536 dims.

I also saw logs like: `401 Unauthorized - multiple Authorization headers` immediately after a retry in Node: `Error: 401 Unauthorized at Client.request (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/src/index.js:112:20)`

carlos_sdk: Two separate regressions: (1) Our Node axios-retry wrapper appended Authorization header again on retries instead of reusing the existing header object. Fix committed to the Node SDK (1.4.2) - it now resets headers before retry. (2) The Python build that went to PyPI accidentally included an experimental quantized alignment shim that padded embeddings to 1537 on one wheel build. That shim was not intended for general release and is reverted in 1.4.3.

carlos_sdk: Short-term workarounds:
- Node: set `retries: 0` in client options or disable the batching helper: `client({ batching: false })`
- Python: normalize embedding namings/lengths in the sampleapp: `vec = resp['data'][0].get('vector') or resp['data'][0].get('embedding'); vec = vec[:1536]`

marie_docs: I'll update the sampleapp to accept both keys and include a `normalize_embedding(resp_item, dim=1536)` helper that trims/pads. Also adding migration notes: minimal SDK versions and the exact fix details.

kate_support: Flagged customer impact: one customer flipped batching helper on in prod and hit crashes. Customer guidance: upgrade Node to >=1.4.2 and Python to >=1.4.3, or temporarily disable the client batching helper and validate embedding length before calling rerank.

emma_devex: Upgraded to the patched SDKs and re-ran CI. Rerank flows green, no retry 401s. Thanks!

carlos_sdk: Release note: node @redwood/sdk v1.4.2 (fix: retry header duplication), python redwood-sdk 1.4.3 (fix: remove accidental embedding padding). Also standardizing response key to `vector` across SDKs; docs will call out compatibility and provide the `normalize_embedding` snippet.

emma_devex: Small follow-up request: can SDK expose an opt-in debug flag that logs header state across retries? Debugging that header duplication took a while.

carlos_sdk: Filing internal issue and proposing `client({ debug: { retryHeaders: true } })` as opt-in telemetry for next minor.

marie_docs: PR will include sampleapp patch, quick migration guide, and a note in onboarding checklist: "confirm embedding shape & key before rerank".

emma_devex: Resolving on our side, leaving thread for the record.
